metadata.description: Ready-to-install Claude Code workflows from Gabriel Omat. Each workflow installs on its own.

plugins.name: meeting-follow-up
plugins.description: Turns a meeting transcript into a plain, facts-only follow-up email with a summary and next steps, labeled as AI-drafted.

plugins.name: animated-wallpapers
plugins.description: Puts an animated wallpaper behind your Claude chats, with six to pick from, and draws new ones from a description.
